authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
note: Previously unused official public no-login real-data source window. Planning Data reports 364 local-plan-boundary records, created by MHCLG, and defines a local-plan boundary as the area a local plan covers. Its specification requires a permanent reference and Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry. A bounded window of at most 50 candidate records was considered solely to resolve the fixed future_growth_3 partition/geography. Round62 remote readback still exposes no authoritative local-plan-boundary reference, organisation/local-authority identifier, local-plan reference, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, title identifier, or equivalent selector binding any candidate boundary to this fixed slot. Choosing one would invent partition ownership. Therefore no coverage_area_id or Polygon/MultiPolygon is selected, no AAYS_SOURCE_AREA_V1 record is accepted, no canonical parcel is accepted, and no future_growth_new Plan0 package is emitted.
